book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Gagalo euda Iesu Keriso umanawa Luk girumalena

content: Iesu bo bedewe enediwisidede
Tane Sande walama pumpu ioto ia asiwa bonabonaua imaala otene bo nagawa mampe anton.
Mo bo ituiena mampentone seu bo nagawa enenbodena rialene winedia eweiena.
Ita mo bo nagawa bedewe odane antone tane Tatamba Iesu etepa mai sape ewapona, dia.
Mo epe ewane memesantone insakoantoio apana nata gara sapusapua kibokiboraua tautaula tauwadea os segantone mo tampo eneie.
Ioto ema saidantone duneidantoio apana nata sa mo diamone waienase, “E dima baiwa mida inawaa wandia apana bolala bedeuwo banusailana?
Me mape dia, me enenwisen! Me e do Galili bedewe wainilano ambi dialena insena. Me e diaimaalene wanase,
‘Apana Otopa ideita nanantopue kadi apana witaposapuo ita koros osowe bosapu, tane walama natadeawo me bo bedewe enepiwisepi.’”
Tauma ioto Iesu aiawa insene
bo nagawa ene leuntone antone dewa uduudu umanawa Iesu wawe alala 11 ita apana isiwa do benemamoiena.
Ioto mida aposel benemamoiena ipa Meri Magdalin, Ioanna ita Iems inawa Meri, tane ioto isiwa do.
Iesu wawe alala ioto etaeta oauaramone baiwa mai sumanaibuntopona.
Tane Pita enenwisene weuwane bo nagawa bedewe alen. Ita sape wirorolene gara kepau mampe Iesu etepa lomantoiena os winamoio ewamone ita me leulene aleidie dima segalena baiwa insakoaleidie.
Iesu wawe alala nata mampo sabamoleide
Walamaipa deawaawo Iesu wawe alala nata Ierusalem ene bola Emausiwa antoie, tane bola sa ipa omo natadea awa rua.
Tane mo nata dewa uduudu Ierusalem bedewe segalena gagalowantoie antoie.
Ita mo dima segalena gagalowantoie insaisawantoio Iesu me meba tampoido wisene ita mo do antoie.
Mo me eweiena tane emau God bodeno Iesu mai ewape atensapona, dia.
Ita Iesu mo waitaramone wanase, “E dima gagalowaitile aitilana?” Me epe waitaraleidio mo nambu nuapare do dainantone eneiena.
Mo sape eneie sowa dea Kileopas Iesu diene wanase, “Apana uduudu oda awa Ierusalem bedewe wimoiena dima no gagalowantitana walama emawo segalena atentoiena, tane ware dea e os ambi mai ateitapona?”

Iesu dima Kileopas wana sipoasane wanase, “E dewa dainea umanawa wailana?” Tane mo sipoasane waienase, “No Nasaret Iesuwa umanawa waitana, me ipa peroweta, God ita apana emauwo me aiawa ita ginasawa do mukamukaua nolaleidie.

Tane no insaisamba badowa me bedewe itute wainite inseitana me ipa sa mida God wanaubeno wisen Israel apanawa saumopie emalawoa apana mampo inamopi! Tane no pirisimba debamau ita onioniamba apanawa Iesu nanantoiena kotusapue bosapua baiwa ita koros osowe bosaiena. Ita me koros osowe bosaieno aupe no nuapare do wainitano tauma walama natadea dianton.
Tane do ande tadinaida ipa epe segalen: No bedembo sosomba isiwa iwoa anton bo nagawa bedewe,
tane Iesu etepa mai ewapona, dia. Tane leuntone wimone no dianene waienase, ‘No ensel auwen rua ewamotana ita mo no dianene waienase, ‘Iesu bo bedewe inalene enenwisen.”
No ioto dima donsaiena umanawa dianeieno etate no sosomba isiwa bo nagawa bedewe antone ioto dima dianeiena rua donsaiena, tane Iesuida mai ibuwa ewapona, dia.”
Mo dima segalena umanawa Iesu dieieno etene me diamone wanase, “Sosona, e insaisala ipa koakoa ita do nuala potawa! E dima peroweta waiena mai inseipe sumanaiwaitipona!
Ne ema epe dialedina, ipawa peroweta bukau bedewe girumalena wadia Keriso no Inawamba wisepie me ideita God insaisawa rua pokaida etepie tauma me sapawaida ita mukawa bedewe odepie waimpa.”
Tauma Iesu me meba umanawa Moses bukawa, peroweta bukau ita do buka kakaibu uduudu bedeuwo girumantoiena ipawaida sabamosane waeuwadewasamon.
Mo bola naepe antoiawo tampe wimone Iesu dewasana ewaewawa abo aidaleipona rua.
Tane mo Iesu wanaitue waienase, “Mai ene aitaa, dia! Winea, no do wankasantata, aitamana rawilene tadina baiwaleide!” Ita Iesu mo aiau ruawalene mampo aleno do dua odane anton.
Tane mo sape wimone me aisidene waine nana napua baiwantoio me bured wadene God auwasane ita ampuialene wanamodio,
tauma mo emau lotone ewane atensaiena me mida. Walama kerauda os mo emauwoido eweio lawosaleno ewanasudeiena.
Mo eweio lawosaleno aupe muba wane waienase, “Intasino me no gagalonedie buka kakaibu bedeuwo me meba umanawa girumantoiena waeuwadewasanedio no nuamba enidasano dauwa etatana!”
Mo epe insene waie tauwadea enanawimone leuntone anton Ierusalemwa. Sape mo wawe alala 11 ita isiwa do auwene waimoio dommone
diamone waienase, “Ulaipa, Tatamba bo bedewe enenwisen ita Saimon mampe sabamoleno ibuwaida ewen!”
Tane dima into segalena ita ambi Iesu bured andipundedio atensaiena umanawa sosou wadewasamoieno eteiena.
Iesu wawe alala uduudu mampo sabamoleide
Wawe alala nata Emausiwae wimone dima segaleno eweiena gagalowa sosou benemamoio Iesu mo sawanauwo segalene enene diamone wanase, “Euda e manlawo winepi!”
Tane wawe alala me ewane memesantone saidantone inseienase, “No nitu da eweitana.”
Tane Iesu mo diamone wanase, “Dima baiwa e inguguraitile ita insaisala ragaragaleidio insakoaitilana?
Witana ita wana pirawa ewamona, neida ipa ema sawanalawo enedina! Ne ibunaida wadaetasane etane ateineana, ipawa nitu da mai etepa wineipona e tauma ne etenaida do ewaneilana rua.”
Me epe wane witapa ita wawa euwamon.
Mo me ibuwa ewane memesantoie do nuaeu nopemono tane mai sumanaiidantopona, dia. Iesu mo insakoau ewedie waitaramone wanase, “Nana da manlawo winede, ba dia?”
Mo bouri nula waiwa waneieno wadene emauwo nan.

Tane me diamone wanase, “Ne e do wainite dewa uduudu tauma segantoio eweilana umanau diadewasalene wanase, ‘Uduudu dima Moses anaanawa, peroweta ita Sam bukau bedeuwo ne umanana girumalena ideita segantopu.’”
Tauma mo insaisau wadenaubeno dima buka kakaiwa bedewe girumalena ipawaida atenton.
Ita me diamone wanase, “Buka kakaiwa bedewe ema epe girumalena winede: Keriso ideita poka etepi, tane walama natadeawo me bo bedewe enepiwisepi.
Ita me ebowa mampe insaisa leuleusawa ita kadi insadabua gagalowa uwa daitada apanawa bedeuwo amonantopu, tane Ierusalem bedewe bauta uwaalepi.
Ita e dewa ema uduudu emalawoido segantoio ewamoile ateitilana benemawaitane aitana.
Tane Aleu kakaiwa Mamana sauawalena ne wapaaubepa e manlawo, tane e ideita Ierusalem bedewe wanlempo muka sa uboa e osolawo iepio wadana!”
Iesu uboo odene alena gagalowa
Iesu epe wano dialeno aupe me wawe alala Ierusalemwae banlamone nosene bola Betani mampentone me witapa wadenposie sau osouwo itun.
Me sau mo osouwo itudie emone wadenposie odene alen uboo.
Tane mo Iesu raupari bedewe wadaposisane ionosaiena ita nuaeu debamaia do leuntone anton Ierusalemwa. Sape mo kainokaino God duwa bedewe antoie God ebowa wadaposisaie waimoie.
